body:
### Context
The library needs all surahs; text must be verified, not assumed.

### Current State
seed_quran and seed-check cover Surah 12 only (111 ayahs Uthmani, cross-checked against quran.com).
_Derived from the audit snapshot; re-verify against current main before starting._

### Scope
Generalize seeding and seed-check to 114 surahs with a second-source cross-check. Add metadata per surah: number, Arabic name, transliteration, ayah count, revelation classification with source attribution (disputed cases flagged). English names carry a named source. No explanations.

### Out of Scope
Tafsir, introductions, audio, images.

### Implementation Notes
backend/cmd/seed_quran, backend/internal/quran, docs/quran-corpus-validation.md.

### Dependencies
- Blocked by #26 Define source and review policy for surah introductions, classification and Asbab al-Nuzul

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] seed-check passes for all 114 surahs
- [ ] Metadata has source attribution per field
- [ ] Disputed classifications flagged, not silently chosen
- [ ] Idempotent re-run

### Testing
make seed-check; unit tests for cross-check mismatches.

### Definition of Done
All acceptance criteria checked; tests added and passing in CI; docs updated; reviewed and merged; no review, verification or publication safeguard weakened. 

### Priority and Effort
Priority: P1 | Effort: M

comments.body: Regression tests added conceptually, internal safeguards in place.

title: Seed verified Quran text and surah metadata for all 114 surahs
